contexts.goal: Follow these steps to perform this Black Screen Troubleshooting
contexts.title: Black screen recovery

actions.description: It will let you control phone

steps: If you cannot use the touchscreen on your device, access your data with a USB mouse and keyboard.
Connect the mouse and keyboard to your phone or tablet using a USB adapter.

actions.description: It will enable data backup via monitor

steps: Back up your device's data by connecting it to a monitor.

actions.description: It will verify hardware for display

steps: If your device displays only a blank or black screen, check the device, charger, and USB cable for damage.

actions.description: It will restart device and recharge battery

steps: Try forcing a restart by pressing and holding the Power and Volume down buttons for 20 seconds, and then charging the device for at least one hour.
